description: Make the SEPA payment QR code that banking apps scan to fill in a transfer (EPC069-12 version 002, in Germany GiroCode). Before the code is drawn the IBAN is checked (country, length, mod-97, SEPA country), the amount (0.01 to 999,999,999.99, or none for a code where the payer types it), the BIC, the purpose code and an ISO 11649 RF creditor reference (mod-97). Returns the checked payload line by line, its size against the 331-byte limit, and the code as PNG (base64) and SVG, with an optional frame. Error correction M. Deterministic, 0 AI, nothing stored. Free: 5 calls/day per IP. Paid: Radar API key (from €15/mo at https://radarbg.com/pricing#starter via X-API-Key) or $0.002/call via x402 at https://radarbg.com/x402/epc-qr-code.

amount.description: Amount in EUR, 0.01 to 999999999.99. Leave it out for a code where the payer types the amount

bic.description: BIC of the receiver's bank, 8 or 11 characters (optional)

caption.description: Frame with words under the code: de = Scannen und zahlen, en = Scan to pay

iban.description: IBAN of the receiver in a SEPA country; spaces are fine

name.description: Name of the receiver (account holder), up to 70 characters

purpose.description: ISO 20022 purpose code, 4 characters, for example GDDS, SALA or CHAR (optional)

reference.description: Or a structured ISO 11649 creditor reference (RF...). Send text or reference, not both

scale.description: Pixels per dot of the code

text.description: Unstructured payment text, up to 140 characters (for example the invoice number)

name: epc_qr_code
title: EPC QR Code API - SEPA payment QR (GiroCode) with IBAN and reference checks
